title: Evaluating OpenAI GPT Models for Translation of Endangered Uralic Languages: A Comparison of Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Architectures
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the performance and refusal rates of GPT models in translating low-resource Uralic languages. While it briefly mentions ethical concerns regarding language equity and access, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, faith-based, moral, or ethical systems.
